description: React component for viewing and selecting different versions of prompts in a side panel, including fetching version data from an API and rendering version details.

methods.name: fetchVersions
methods.description: Fetches the list of prompt versions from the API and updates state.

methods.name: getVersionNumber
methods.description: Determines the version string to display for a given prompt object.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a date string into a locale-specific string, or returns a placeholder if undefined.
